cues.zh: 它們都是被設計和製造成用作工具的手錶。

cues.en: And so that's their bread and butter and it still is today.

cues.text: It kind of evolved into a luxury brand later in life which now is what they're known for.
cues.en: It kind of evolved into a luxury brand later in life which now is what they're known for.
cues.zh: 後來它逐漸演變成一個奢侈品牌，現在他們也因此而聞名。

cues.text: So that's kind of the interesting thing about them is they initially were tool watches which have now become luxury.
cues.en: So that's kind of the interesting thing about them is they initially were tool watches which have now become luxury.
cues.zh: 因此，它們的有趣之處在於它們最初是工具表，現在已成為奢侈品。

cues.en: Rolex is kind of one of those brands that sits on the lower end of the spectrum

cues.en: The Submariner's $8,000.

cues.en: The entry-level watch at Rolex is $5,000 with the Oyster Perpetual.

cues.en: Their three qualities are self-winding, waterproof and precision.

cues.en: And they really focus on quality.

cues.en: It takes one year to make a Rolex.
cues.zh: 製作一塊勞力士需要一年的時間。

cues.text: They go through extensive testing.
cues.en: They go through extensive testing.
cues.zh: 他們經過廣泛的測試。

cues.text: The accuracy, the chronometer, the timing, it's all about telling the right time,
cues.en: The accuracy, the chronometer, the timing, it's all about telling the right time,
cues.zh: 準確性、天文鐘、計時，這一切都是為了告訴正確的時間，

cues.text: keeping the right time.
cues.en: keeping the right time.
cues.zh: 保持正確的時間。

cues.en: They also have extensive service work after, so if you ever have a problem with your Rolex,

cues.text: you can take it to them and they'll fix it.
cues.en: you can take it to them and they'll fix it.

cues.text: The clasp is opened and closed a thousand times before it leaves so you know that when you get it,
cues.en: The clasp is opened and closed a thousand times before it leaves so you know that when you get it,
cues.zh: 扣環在離開之前會被開啟和關閉一千次，所以你知道當你拿到它時，

cues.text: it's not gonna break.
cues.en: it's not gonna break.
cues.zh: 它不會破裂。

cues.text: The whole point of a Rolex is you buy one now, it will last you for 20 years if you take care of it.
cues.en: The whole point of a Rolex is you buy one now, it will last you for 20 years if you take care of it.
cues.zh: 勞力士的全部意義在於，你現在買一塊，如果你保養得當，它可以用20年。

cues.text: It will last you for 100 if you really take care of it.
cues.en: It will last you for 100 if you really take care of it.
cues.zh: 如果你真的好好照顧它，它會持續你100年。

cues.text: That's ultimately why they're so expensive because you're buying something
cues.en: That's ultimately why they're so expensive because you're buying something
cues.zh: 這就是它們如此昂貴的最終原因，因為你要買東西

cues.text: that will last you a lifetime presumably.
cues.en: that will last you a lifetime presumably.
cues.zh: 這可能會讓你終生受益。

cues.en: And something that you can pass down to other generations as well.
cues.zh: 還有一些你也可以傳承給其他世代的東西。

cues.text: In the collectors' world, there's the vintage Rolex market.
cues.en: In the collectors' world, there's the vintage Rolex market.
cues.zh: 在收藏家的世界裡，有古董勞力士市場。

cues.text: And there's a whole underground of different nuances
cues.en: And there's a whole underground of different nuances
cues.zh: 整個地下有不同的細微差別

cues.text: and you know there's a GMT with a matte dial, a GMT with a gilt dial and there are all these tiny little details
cues.en: and you know there's a GMT with a matte dial, a GMT with a gilt dial and there are all these tiny little details
cues.zh: 你知道有磨砂錶盤的 GMT 和鍍金錶盤的 GMT，還有所有這些微小的細節

cues.en: that change and they make a watch more or less valuable.
cues.zh: 這種變化會使手錶的價值或多或少增加。

cues.text: There's the Paul Newman Daytona which sold for $17.8 million last fall
cues.en: There's the Paul Newman Daytona which sold for $17.8 million last fall
cues.zh: Paul Newman Daytona 去年秋天以 1,780 萬美元的價格售出

cues.en: and that's the most expensive Rolex that's ever sold at auction.
cues.zh: 這是有史以來在拍賣會上售出的最昂貴的勞力士手錶。

cues.en: The Paul Newman Daytona is a really good example where they came out with a Daytona back in the 70s

cues.en: and they put these exotic dials on them and they couldn't sell them.
cues.zh: 他們把這些異國情調的錶盤裝在上面，卻賣不出去。

cues.en: And now they're the most collectible watches on the vintage market.
cues.zh: 現在它們是古董市場上最具收藏價值的手錶。

cues.en: No one knows how many Rolexes are produced per year, no one knows how many Rolexes are produced per model.

cues.text: But there are specific ones, like the Rainbow Daytona that came out this year,
cues.en: But there are specific ones, like the Rainbow Daytona that came out this year,
cues.zh: 但也有一些具體的，像是今年推出的Rainbow Daytona，

cues.en: You don't ever know exactly what the number is, but you do know that there aren't that many.
cues.zh: 你永遠不知道確切的數字是多少，但你確實知道沒有那麼多。

cues.text: And they're hard to get.
cues.en: And they're hard to get.

cues.en: on watches and kind of brand it as a woman's watch.

cues.en: Whereas Rolex does the same thing, but it's kind of unisex.

cues.en: I wear a lot of men's Rolex.

cues.en: But the ladies Datejust is actually, in two-tone, is actually the most sold Rolex model of all time.
cues.zh: 但女式日誌型實際上是雙色的，是勞力士有史以來最暢銷的型號。
